variants.name: Light Discs
variants.info: Lightweight 'pancakes' that improve the bullet speed but decrease accuracy, supppresion, and increases spread.

variants.name: Heavy Discs
variants.info: Improves the spread with heavier 'pancakes', with stronger suppression. Range is more evenly spread. Bullets drop faster.

variants.name: Pennies
variants.info: Instead of large discs you loaded the magazine with pennies. That's one way to spend your money... your reserve ammo now equates to about 3 dollars.
